sources.entry: Speed Reader - Read faster with the power of silencing vocalization with SpeedReader.

summary.one_liner: SpeedReader is a macOS app for speed reading pasted or imported articles, showing words in a focused view with adjustable speed, font, and layout.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS app where you paste in an article, set a reading speed, and pick a font, then read it in a focus view. An article library lets you organize, preview, and reopen articles you have already speed read, and you can import local articles or webpages. The focus view offers a distraction-free layout with an optional dark theme and accessibility options for legibility. It supports customizing typeface, font weight, font size, and the number of words shown per screen. The app detects the article's language to split phrases more sensibly. A single preferences pane controls speed, font, focus appearance, content language, and words per roll.
use_cases: Speed read a pasted article on a Mac
Read web pages in a focused, distraction-free view
Practice reading faster with adjustable word-per-screen display
Keep a library of articles already read
Read local article files with a rapid word-by-word display
how_to_run: Download from GitHub (link in the README; no build commands given)
notable: Automatic language detection to split phrases for speed reading
Article library with preview and reopen of past reads
Focus view with dark theme and customizable typeface, weight, size, and words per screen
caveats: README gives no explicit minimum macOS version beyond mentioning Mojave dark mode
No build or install instructions; download link only
README does not state a license or maintenance status
